clause: Navigation actions: navigate-to-frame, back, open-link + change-to variant switch [STU-PRO-014a,STU-PRO-014b,STU-PRO-014c,STU-PRO-014f]

scope.summary: Implement the navigation + variant actions on StudioPrototypeFlow: navigate to frame (replaces the top-level frame, pushing prototype history); back (pops navigation history); open link (opens an external URL, local viewer defers to OS handler); and change-to variant switch (switches an instance, incl. nested, to another variant in place via the MT-332 switch path). Runtime behavior is deterministic and history-correct.
expected_tests: live: navigate pushes history; back pops it; open-link defers to OS handler; change-to switches instance variant in place (incl. nested)
acceptance_criteria_original: navigate-to-frame + back + open-link + change-to variant switch; history-correct; reuses MT-332 switch

Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: | Navigate to frame | [STU-PRO-014a] | replaces the top-level frame with a destination, pushing prototype history |
| Back | [STU-PRO-014b] | pops navigation history to the previous frame |
| Change to (variant switch) | [STU-PRO-014c] | switches an instance (incl. nested) to another variant in place ([STU-DS-008]) |
| Open link | [STU-PRO-014f] | opens an external URL (local viewer defers to OS handler) |

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
